text: ASIC efficiency crossed 3.5 J/TH with Bitmain's S21 Pro (shipped late 2023), almost half the 6.9 J/TH baseline of the S19 XP from two years before, which is part of why network hashrate kept climbing past 700 EH/s through 2024 even after the April 20 2024 halving cut block subsidy from 6.25 to 3.125 BTC and pushed hashprice below roughly 45 dollars per PH/s per day for months.
